name: Knife Duels
creator: KNIFE DUELS Team
redeem: Launch Knife Duels on Roblox and win duels until you reach level 10.
In the lobby, walk to the red gift box next to the shop.
Hold E (or tap the prompt on mobile) to open the codes box.
Type or paste a code exactly as written and press Redeem to get your cash.
notes:
Knife Duels is a first-person fighting game where every player uses only a knife. You step on a duel pad in the lobby to start a match, from 1v1 up to 4v4, and the first side to win six rounds takes the duel. Wins earn you coins and push you up the leaderboard.

Codes in this game give cash, usually 3,000 at a time, which you spend on knife cases in the shop to unbox new skins. Skins are only cosmetic, but rare ones can be traded with other players, so saving up for a pricier case can be worth it. New codes show up with updates and group milestones, like 1MILGROUP for one million group members, and they are shared in the Discord.

faq.q: Why can't I open the codes box in Knife Duels?
faq.a: The gift box only works once your account is level 10. Keep playing duels to level up, then go back to the gift box by the shop.

faq.q: What should I buy with Knife Duels code cash?
faq.a: Cash goes toward knife cases in the shop. Cases are random, so it can help to save a few codes' worth of cash and open the case with the skins you want most.

faq.q: Why does DYNAMIC or SORRYABOUTRANKED not work anymore?
faq.a: Both of those codes have expired. If a newer code fails, try joining a fresh server, since old servers sometimes do not load new codes.

codeChannels: The official Knife Duels Discord server and the KNIFE DUELS Team Roblox group
requirement: You must be level 10 before the codes box accepts codes.
